description: This Java interface defines a contract for metric instruments that can be tagged with key-value pairs, enabling flexible labeling and categorization of metrics within the system. It provides methods for adding, retrieving, and managing tags associated with metric instruments.

classes.name: TaggedMetricInstrument
classes.description: An interface for metric instruments that support tagging with key-value pairs, allowing for flexible metric categorization and filtering.

methods.name: tag
methods.description: Adds a tag with a key and an overloaded method for different value types (long, double, boolean, String) to the metric instrument, returning the instance for chaining.

methods.name: tags
methods.description: Adds multiple tags from a map, overriding existing tags with the same keys.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a specific tag key, or null if not present.

methods.name: getTags
methods.description: Returns a map of all tags currently associated with the metric instrument.
